title: Commands of God
definition: The commands of God are His revealed instructions in Scripture, showing His will and calling His people to faithful love, holiness, justice, worship, and obedience.
summary: God's commands guide redeemed people in the way of love and life.
christFocus: Jesus fulfilled the law and teaches His people to obey from love, faith, and dependence on Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's commands are not arbitrary restrictions. They reveal His holy will and guide His people in what is good, wise, and faithful.

For believers, obedience to God's commands is not a way to earn salvation. It is the fruit of love, faith, and new life in Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often treat commands as burdens or ignore them in the name of grace. The commands of God matter because grace trains believers to obey the Lord who saved them.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Do not separate love for God from obedience to God. Identify what He commands clearly and ask for grace to obey with joy and humility.
